test: PAR9 suggested setup lets the owner edit, choose, apply and dismiss without changing other settings
expected: the Jevellan web app "PAR9 suggested" screen at desktop-dark, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "PAR9 suggested setup lets the owner edit, choose, apply and dismiss without changing other settings"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: Each suggested-setup checkbox sits on its own line above its label instead of beside it, which makes the checkbox-to-label link weaker.
The Overview tab row runs to the right edge of the panel, and the 'Library' pill touches the boundary. More tabs may be hidden past the edge.
Sidebar session titles and subtitles are cut off with ellipses (e.g. 'Context · Mesh journey fixt…'). This looks intended but hides the full names.
The suggested-setup form is long, so the 'Apply setup' and 'Not now' buttons are far below the first item and need scrolling to reach.
